args.prompt:
Create a new KFB soft claymation ink blob sprite sheet, The Executive Tangle. Fictional political satire about roles and procedures. The original image inputs guide organic full-body dark charcoal-plum blob forms and sculpted face construction. Exactly six unique independent standalone complete footless ink blobs, three columns by two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Faces sculpted directly in continuous goo with thick dark filled eyelids, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Give each a different compact curved body shape, varying natural lower edges and soft attached side lobes. Mix narrow tapered ends, round curves and irregular splats. No standardized foot base, humanoid torso, long jackets, necks, separate legs or shoes. Wear only a tiny pin, glasses, short tab or narrow band if needed. Keep each prop close to the upper belly or side and preserve the complete body outline. Tiny dark ink hands. Smooth satin clay, sparse broad hand marks, clean glass and soft fabric folds. No dense stipple. Teeth behind lips. Clear gutters, no scenery, shadow disc, stage, frame, typography, branding, party or official national insignia. Strongly varied expressive moods and recognizable small tools. Slate blue, subdued burgundy and old brass. Tiny pins and short sash accents.
Row-major roles:
1. Male-read fictional chancellor. broad round splat, composed heavy lids, slight smile. Key cue: short agenda stack with six visible unmarked color tabs.
2. Female-read fictional president. tall tapered drop, raised formal brow and serene closed mouth. Key cue: single oversized blank state seal with an abstract star, held by a small handle.
3. Male-read fictional government spokesperson. compact narrow curl, tense eyebrows and crooked half-smile. Key cue: tiny cluster of two microphones and a short blank quote card.
4. Female-read fictional party leader. low wavy bean, hard sideways stare, compressed lips. Key cue: small wooden tally frame with big sliding beads.
5. Male-read fictional vice chancellor. wide heartlike blob, watchful gaze and uncertain smile. Key cue: two stacked blank folders with one much smaller spare pencil.
6. Male-read fictional opposition leader. upright asymmetrical splat, arched skeptical brow and open retort. Key cue: short oversized pencil and a plain paper marked with one orange zigzag.
Use six clearly differentiated expressions, props and silhouettes. Render every figure complete with clear alpha separation.

material_change: Gentle charcoal/plum satin clay with broader sparse surface marks and smoother liquid, plastic and glass props.
